recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century studio portrait of a man in a sharp grey suit sitting atop a vintage black steamer trunk adorned with colorful travel stickers. To his right stands a coat rack holding rustic items like a straw hat and work boots, contrasting with his urban attire against a warm, ochre-brown studio backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject sitting centrally on a horizontal trunk anchor
Vertical coat rack balancing the left-aligned heavy typography
Color contrast between the ochre background and the bright yellow/white text blocks
coreInvariants: Black steamer trunk with brass hardware
Subject in a grey three-button suit

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame, scaled to appear approachable yet prominent.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large black steamer trunk at the bottom center acts as the primary weight and base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large yellow title at top-left, move down through the white artist name, then right to the subject's face, and finally down to the trunk stickers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous ochre-brown space at the top and sides allows the dense typography and subject to breathe.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mustard Yellow (Primary title) and White (Artist name)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast text against a medium-value, warm-toned background with low-saturation clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones, black, white, and primary yellow.

letterConstructionRules: Stencil-style horizontal breaks in vertical strokes
Flat terminals and uniform stroke width
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation points rendered as thick vertical bars with square dots
Stencil gaps placed consistently at the mid-point of vertical stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying colors (yellow vs white) within the same stencil family to distinguish title from artist.

avoid: Centered text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photo of a man in a grey suit sitting on a black steamer trunk with colorful stickers. To the right is a wooden coat rack with a straw hat and boots. Background is a solid ochre-brown wall. High-key lighting from the front-left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of ultra-bold condensed stencil text in the top-left corner. The first line in mustard yellow, the following lines in black and white. Ensure the text is left-aligned and tightly stacked.

verificationChecks: Is the stencil gap present in the vertical strokes?
Is the background a consistent warm ochre tone?
Are the stickers on the trunk colorful and varied?
Is the text left-justified and condensed?

mustRedesign: Change specific sticker text to generic travel icons
Alter facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for stencil-style breaks in all display letters
Verify the trunk has brass-style hardware
Ensure the coat rack is visually distinct from the subject
Confirm the ochre background is matte and non-distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject on Trunk + Left-Aligned Stencil Typography + Ochre Studio Backdrop = 1960s Soul Aesthetic
